runs.question: What does the memo require agencies to do within 180 days?

answer.text:
Under OMB M-25-21, the 180-day deadline applies to compliance plans. Within 180 days of the issuance of this memorandum or any update to this memorandum, and every two years thereafter until 2036, each agency must submit to 0MB and post publicly on the agency's website either a plan to achieve consistency with this memorandum, or a written determination that the agency does not use and does not anticipate using covered AI. Those plans must also address internal AI rules: agencies must also include plans to update any existing internal AI principles and guidelines to ensure consistency with this memorandum.

The memo's summary table on page 25 also lists 180-day entries, but the text extraction doesn't map them to specific actions, so I have not relied on it. Otherwise the 180-day requirement above is the one the passages state.
